cues.text: Welcome to AI Horizon, a fast arcade space shooter.
Launch the mission. You have ninety seconds to score as many points as you can.
Collect stars along the way. White stars are worth twenty-five points, red bonus stars fifty.
Blast the asteroids. Hardened gray planets take many hits, but pay out a hundred points.
The red planets are the eight bonus asteroids, worth two hundred and fifty points each.
Aim carefully. Your shot accuracy earns an end-of-run bonus.
There goes a red bonus planet: two hundred and fifty points.
Every thousand points adds another two hundred and fifty.
Don't get hit. One asteroid collision forces you to eject and ends the run.
Stay sharp. The asteroid waves keep on coming.
Fifteen seconds left. Every point now counts double!
Past twenty-five hundred points, your bullets upgrade: hardened and bonus asteroids take fifty percent fewer hits.
Survive to the end for the full score.
Your AI commanders, Vega and Altair, powered by Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Polly and ElevenLabs, remember your missions and tell you how to improve.
Post your score to the leaderboard. Download AI Horizon on Google Play, and beat the high score!
